{{Top|leg}}
'''Grumbog''' was a non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] who operated prior to [[Sia-Lan Wezz]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]]. Grumbog had a [[Grumbog's space station fortress|space station fortress]] and at least three [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. A mission team involving Sia-Lan Wezz, [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], and [[Vor'en Kurn]] infiltrated Grumbog's fortress and fought in its corridors.
